scope: Actual Linux-backed openat behavior when protection class is DEFAULT (-1), or when O_CREAT is absent and the class is ignored as in XNU. Nondefault creation classes and raw/authentication flags fail explicitly. No encrypted-file protection implementation.
existing_backend_limit: Existing Darling open_dprotected_np ignores protection class/flags and calls sys_open. This adapter does not extend that behavior to nondefault protection requests.
known_backend_differences: The current path expander accepts -1 as an internal cwd descriptor; this entry point validates relative-path descriptors with fcntl to preserve EBADF.
Existing symlinkat ignores its directory descriptor. The test creates its symlink fixture by absolute pathname; that base API is unchanged.
